current_affairs.title: Cabinet Approves High-Level Committee Recommendations on 'One Nation, One Election'
current_affairs.summary: The Union Cabinet accepted the recommendations of the Ram Nath Kovind-led committee to conduct simultaneous elections for the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies in the first phase, followed by local body elections within 100 days.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Important for questions on Constitutional Amendments (Article 83, 172), Federalism, Law Commission reports, and Electoral Reforms.

current_affairs.title: Government Launches Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) for Central Employees
current_affairs.summary: The Centre introduced the Unified Pension Scheme, combining features of the National Pension System (NPS) and Old Pension Scheme (OPS). It guarantees an assured pension of 50% of the average basic pay for employees with 25+ years of service.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Relevant for fiscal policy debates, government budget constraints, social security measures, and public administration reforms.

current_affairs.title: ISRO Completes Key Tests for Gaganyaan Crew Module Recovery
current_affairs.summary: ISRO and the Indian Navy successfully carried out simulated recovery operations of the Gaganyaan Crew Module, moving closer to India's first human spaceflight mission.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Key topic for space technology, indigenization of tech, and India's achievements in Science and Technology.

current_affairs.title: Ecological Concerns Raised Over Great Nicobar Island Development Project
current_affairs.summary: Environmentalists and indigenous rights groups have highlighted severe threats to the Shompen and Nicobarese tribes, as well as fragile coral ecosystems, due to the mega transshipment port and infrastructure push.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Pertains to Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs), coastal zone regulation, and balancing ecology vs. strategic infrastructure.

current_affairs.title: India Strengthens Maritime Diplomacy in the Western Indian Ocean under SAGAR
current_affairs.summary: India has deployed naval assets and expanded capacity-building initiatives with Indian Ocean Region (IOR) littoral states like Mauritius, Seychelles, and Madagascar to counter maritime piracy and ensure regional security.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Crucial for topics on SAGAR initiative, Net Security Provider role in the IOR, UNCLOS, and Geopolitics of the Indo-Pacific.
